data.comment:
# Comfy MAI Image 2.6 Flash- Image Edit

Edit images with MAI Image 2.6 Flash, Microsoft's fast image-to-image model that transforms a single input image into a refined output. Ideal for quick retouching, style adjustments, and rapid concept iteration. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_openrouter_mai_image_26_flash_image_edit.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: The clothing presents a realistic 3D effect as if worn on a human figure, rotating slightly to the left, with a white background.
